newsitem.title: USA: Fisher Scientific sets rights dividend.
newsitem.headline: Fisher Scientific sets rights dividend.

text.p: Fisher Scientific International Inc said on Monday that it declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding share of common stock as a takeover defense.
The rights will not prevent a takeover, but will encourage companies to negotiate with the board prior to attempting a takeover, the company said.
As previously announced by Fisher, Trinity I Fund LP has accumulated more than 10 percent of Fisher's stock and has made proposals to recapitalize Fisher.
Trinity indicated its intention to continue to accumulate shares, the company said.

The rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of Fisher's common stock or announces a tender offer the consummation of which would result in ownership by a person or group of 15 percent or more of the common stock, the company said.
Each right will entitle stockholders to buy one one-hundredth of a share of a new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise prise of $190.
Each right would enable the company's shareholders, except the acquirer, to buy its common stock at a discount to market value, Fisher said.

The dividend distribution will be made on June 19, 1997, payable to stockholders of record on that date. The rights will expire on June 8, 2007. The rights distribution is not taxable to stockholders.
